now.title: What If...?
now.text: In season 1, Nebula and Star-Lord T'Challa's Ravagers steal the Embers.

proposed.text: In season 1, Nebula and Star-Lord T'Challa's Ravagers steal the Embers, and Nebula feeds some to Cull Obsidian, overgrowing Knowhere as they escape.

changes.evidence: What If...? episode 2: after the heist, Nebula forces Cull Obsidian to ingest some of the Embers, turning him into a spawn of vegetation that overtakes Knowhere, and the Ravagers leave with the rest to feed dying worlds. Once stolen the Embers are being used, not still held (same rule as the 0-8-4 'In use' fix).

owner_calls.question: Step 4 (season 2, Battle of New York 2012) has status 'Lost', but the episode shows Loki using the Tesseract to power the accelerator that opens the Chitauri portal, then being beaten by Carter and Natasha and taken into S.H.I.E.L.D. custody. Nothing on screen says the cube is lost. Which status should it have?
options: In use (Loki uses it in this record's event)
Secured (S.H.I.E.L.D. takes Loki into custody after the battle)
owner_calls.evidence: Fandom Tesseract page, Super Soldier Peggy Carter section: 'Loki obtained the Tesseract and used it to power an upgraded Tesseract Accelerator, opening a portal to let the Chitauri invade Earth during the Battle of New York until the Avengers stopped him.' The Battle of New York (Super Soldier Peggy Carter) page: 'With Loki defeated and taken into S.H.I.E.L.D. custody, the Chitauri Invasion was stopped.' Neither says what happens to the cube.
